subject: Important Update: Changes to our Customer Support Hours
body: Dear valued customers, we wanted to inform you about some changes to our customer support hours. Starting next week, our customer support team will be available from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM on weekdays, and from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM on weekends. We hope this adjustment will better serve your needs. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to us. Thank you for your understanding and continued support.
